headlines.title: Robots and surge pricing won't save fast food: Robert Irvine
headlines.summary: World-class chef and entrepreneur, Robert Irvine explains to Yahoo Finance Executive Editor Brian Sozzi why dynamic pricing is a little much, and why McDonald's burger-flipping robot and Chipotle's avocado-peeling machine can't replace the one thing that actually keeps customers coming back.

headlines.title: The business mistake McDonald's and Chipotle keep making: Robert Irvine
headlines.summary: World-class chef and entrepreneur, Robert Irvine explains to Yahoo Finance Executive Editor Brian Sozzi how he helped push through the legislative change that's replacing 50-year-old Army mess halls with campus-style dining

headlines.title: Should You Avoid McDonald's Stock, Even Near a 4-Year Low?
headlines.summary: The company's U.S. sales have been challenging.

headlines.title: The top 5 analyst questions from McDonald's’s Q3 2026 earnings call
headlines.summary: McDonald's third quarter saw a significant positive market response, driven by improved profitability despite missing Wall Street’s revenue expectations. Management attributed the margin outperformance to disciplined cost control, refranchising efforts, and the impact of targeted digital offers that reversed declining U.S. traffic late in the quarter.

headlines.title: McDonald’s Just Became a Dividend King. Is It Still a Buy for Retirement?
headlines.summary: Fifty years of dividend hikes sound bulletproof, but McDonald's U.S. traffic is sliding while debt costs climb. The cash coverage numbers and one balance sheet cushion reveal how much room retirees really have.

description: McDonald's Corporation owns, operates, and franchises restaurants under the McDonald's brand in the United States and internationally. It offers food and beverages, including hamburgers and cheeseburgers, various chicken sandwiches, fries, shakes, frozen desserts, sundaes, soft serve cones, cookies, pies, soft drinks, coffee, and other beverages; and full or limited breakfast, as well as sells various other products during limited-time promotions. The company owns and operates franchised restaurants under various structures, including conventional franchise, developmental license, or affiliate. McDonald's Corporation was founded in 1940 and is based in Chicago, Illinois.
